💥 feat(greeter)!: add excited flag and greet_many

Refactors `greet` to accept an optional `excited` keyword argument for enthusiastic outputs. Introduces `greet_many` to process lists of names efficiently. Maintains backward compatibility for existing callers while expanding demo capabilities.

Included changes:
- ✨ feat(greeter): add greet_many batch function
